beats.label: S1 · The first kilo
beats.text: In summer 1983 South Central, teen weed dealer Franklin Saint takes a kilo of cocaine from Israeli dealer Avi Drexler and unloads it through nightclub owner Claudia.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes Franklin's jump from weed to coke and introduces the Avi/Claudia pipeline that funds his rise.

beats.label: S1 · The CIA man
beats.text: CIA agent Teddy McDonald inherits a dead colleague's off-books operation moving cocaine to fund the Nicaraguan Contras, partnered with fighter Alejandro Usteves.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets up the covert supply chain that will eventually plug into Franklin — the show's central engine.

beats.label: S1 · Villanueva coup
beats.text: Cartel enforcer Gustavo Zapata joins Villanueva cousins Lucia and Pedro against patriarch Ramiro; Gustavo and Lucia become lovers and kill Ramiro at a family funeral.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Gustavo and Lucia in charge of the Mexican side — the pipeline that will eventually feed Teddy and Franklin.

beats.label: S1 · Our future
beats.text: Wandering the neighbourhood, Franklin watches cocaine cooked into crack in an old Black Panthers building and returns to his crew calling it "our future."
beats.whyLoadBearing: The pivot from powder to crack is the whole premise of the show; nothing else in the season matters as much.

beats.label: S1 · Alejandro buried
beats.text: Teddy kills Alejandro to bury a witness who could unravel the operation, then signs a new supply deal with the Cali Cartel's Diego and Danilo.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Teddy's original partner and locks in the Cali supply Franklin will draw from next season.

beats.label: S1 · The Family
beats.text: Franklin, uncle Jerome, best friend Leon and Kevin form "The Family," buy a cook house, and Franklin becomes Teddy's street distributor — neither man yet knows who the other truly is.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Family and the Franklin–Teddy partnership are the two structures the entire remaining series is built on.

cliffhanger.text: The Family has a cook house running and Franklin is buying cocaine from Teddy, both sides unaware that the other is CIA and gang, respectively.
questions: How large can Franklin scale the Family before rival dealers push back?
What happens when Teddy finds out his customer is a Black street crew?
Can Gustavo and Lucia hold the Villanueva cartel now that they've killed for it?

characters.name: Franklin Saint
characters.line: Nineteen-year-old dealer running the newly formed Family and unknowingly buying cocaine from a CIA agent.

characters.name: Teddy McDonald
characters.line: CIA officer running the cocaine-for-Contras black op; his cover is a translation agency.

characters.name: Gustavo "El Oso" Zapata
characters.line: Wrestler-turned-enforcer now sharing control of the Villanueva cartel with his lover Lucia.

characters.name: Lucia Villanueva
characters.line: Cartel heiress who ordered her uncle Ramiro's murder to take over the family business with Gustavo.

characters.name: Jerome Saint
characters.line: Franklin's uncle and former weed supplier, now his junior partner in the crack trade.

characters.name: Louie Jones
characters.line: Jerome's on–off girlfriend, the connection who first put Franklin in front of Claudia.

characters.name: Leon Simmons
characters.line: Franklin's oldest friend and the Family's main enforcer.

characters.name: Kevin Hamilton
characters.line: Franklin's friend in the Family; the one who set up their aborted Oakland deal.

characters.name: Cissy Saint
characters.line: Franklin's mother, who has thrown him out of the house over his drug money.

characters.name: Avi Drexler
characters.line: Israeli mid-level supplier who gave Franklin his first kilo and remains his direct cocaine source.

beats.label: S2 · Teddy finds Franklin
beats.text: With Contra funding cut, Ballard orders Teddy to expand distribution; Teddy pulls Avi's arrest files, gets Franklin's name, and follows him from Jerome's.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Franklin and Teddy formally partner up here — the relationship the whole rest of the show revolves around.

beats.label: S2 · Delroy killed
beats.text: Monarcas enforcer Conejo murders Kevin's cousin Delroy on Stomper's orders, opening a rift between Franklin and Kevin over how to respond.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Plants the Franklin–Kevin conflict that resolves in Kevin's death and Franklin's arrest.

beats.label: S2 · Pedro unmasked
beats.text: DEA agent Lorena Cardenas has been undercover as Pedro's fiancée Soledad; Lucia realises Pedro flipped as revenge for Ramiro, and shoots him in cold blood.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Cardenas as the new law-enforcement threat and removes Pedro, leaving Lucia isolated.

beats.label: S2 · Kevin's grave
beats.text: Cardenas arrests Gustavo and Lucia, then baits Kevin toward Conejo through Franklin; when Kevin refuses to stand down, Franklin shoots and kills his own friend.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The murder of Kevin is the show's moral hinge for Franklin and the crime that gets him arrested.

beats.label: S2 · Cardenas flipped
beats.text: The CIA shuts down the DEA probe on Teddy, and Teddy convinces Cardenas to join his side by promising she can arrest everyone once the Contras win.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns the show's most dangerous law-enforcement threat into a CIA asset, protecting the whole operation.

beats.label: S2 · Back to work
beats.text: Cardenas recants her statement, Franklin walks out of jail harder and colder, pays Avi off, and re-partners with Teddy at Kevin's grave.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reboots the operation with a scaled-up Franklin and closes his origin story arc.

beats.label: S2 · The government
beats.text: Alone that same night, Franklin realises for the first time that his supplier Teddy actually works for the US government.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This dawning knowledge changes the meaning of every choice Franklin makes from here on.

cliffhanger.text: Franklin is out of jail and knows his supplier is a US intelligence officer — a secret he hasn't disclosed to anyone. Lucia and Gustavo have been released from custody but the DEA hasn't given up the chase.
questions: What does Franklin do with the knowledge that Teddy is CIA?
Can Cardenas actually live with what she has agreed to for Teddy?
Who runs the Mexican side of the pipeline now that Lucia is gone?

characters.name: Franklin Saint
characters.line: Back on the streets, harder after prison, now knows Teddy is a US government agent.

characters.name: Teddy McDonald
characters.line: CIA officer running Franklin, having converted DEA agent Cardenas into his protector.

characters.name: Gustavo "El Oso" Zapata
characters.line: Freed from custody and badly wounded fighting Conejo after he attacks Lucia; still her partner at season's end.

characters.name: Cissy Saint
characters.line: Reunited with Franklin, unconditional in her love but still opposed to what he does.

characters.name: Alton Williams
characters.line: Franklin's father, back living with Cissy after being brought home from the hospital and kept out of jail on an LAPD assault suit.

characters.name: Jerome Saint
characters.line: Fully integrated into the Family alongside his nephew.

characters.name: Louie Jones
characters.line: Working the club with Jerome and increasingly ambitious inside the Family.

characters.name: Leon Simmons
characters.line: Still Franklin's main enforcer; spends the season arrested with Avi, kidnapped by Teddy, and locking up Wanda to detox her off crack.

characters.name: Lorena Cardenas
characters.line: Former DEA agent turned Teddy's asset, disgusted by what she agreed to.

beats.label: S3 · Off the corners
beats.text: Five months later, Franklin pulls the Family back from street corners; new Crips wholesaler Manboy takes the retail load, and Franklin brokers Family crack into Bloods territory through Skully.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Restructures how the Family operates and plants Manboy and Skully — the two poles of the coming gang war.

beats.label: S3 · Alton clocks Teddy
beats.text: Alton pieces together that Franklin is working with Teddy and warns him off.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Alton–Teddy collision started here is what gets Alton killed and turns Cissy into an assassin.

beats.label: S3 · Cardenas killed
beats.text: Teddy sends Cardenas to pick up a shipment from Gustavo, who kills her; the body is dissolved, but her boss Marino privately keeps digging into Teddy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Kills the last honest law-enforcement thread and gives Marino the personal grudge he carries for years.

beats.label: S3 · Andre dies
beats.text: Melody's father, LAPD officer Andre, breaks into Franklin's house and steals a CIA file that names Teddy; Franklin murders him, stages it as a suicide, and takes the file back.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Franklin killing a friend of his family is the crime Melody eventually confronts him with, and the moral point of no return.

beats.label: S3 · Julia burns Teddy
beats.text: Teddy's ex-wife Julia, disgusted by the operation, tips off the Israelis and Colombians to force Teddy out; he catches her, promises to end her career, and she leaves.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends Teddy's family life and hardens him into the man who kills journalists next season.

beats.label: S3 · Vasco flipped
beats.text: Colombian kingpin Rigo Vasco discovers Teddy is CIA and, rather than kill him, agrees to become a CIA asset — the operation now spans two cartels and one Contra army.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Expands Teddy's empire to Medellín scale and gives Franklin the pipeline he'll operate on for the rest of the show.

beats.label: S3 · Melody's window
beats.text: Melody, spiralling on crack after Franklin's world engulfs her, unlocks her window, waits for him to climb in as he always has, and shoots him.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Ends the season with Franklin's life in the balance — the direct setup for the S4 opener's time-jump.

cliffhanger.text: Franklin has survived being shot and is back in the game, walking with a cane. The Bloods–Crips gang war has erupted, his murder of Andre is still buried — but he has told Teddy to his face that he knows he is CIA.
questions: How does he keep control of the streets during a full gang war?
Will Melody live with what she has done — or come after him again?

characters.name: Franklin Saint
characters.line: The Family's boss, pulled off the corners into wholesale; shot on Melody's living room floor.

characters.name: Teddy McDonald
characters.line: Running two cartels for the CIA after Julia's sabotage failed and Vasco flipped to his side.

characters.name: Gustavo "El Oso" Zapata
characters.line: Teddy's Mexican side hand, quietly buying houses for Hernan and his family.

characters.name: Cissy Saint
characters.line: Reunited with Alton, the family's moral centre, still shielding Franklin.

characters.name: Alton Williams
characters.line: Now aware Franklin is working with Teddy — wary and warning him off.

characters.name: Jerome Saint
characters.line: Family enforcer; brutally beaten during the LAPD raids Andre orchestrated.

characters.name: Louie Jones
characters.line: Expecting a baby with Jerome and stepping deeper into the Family after making a drop to Manboy for Leon.

characters.name: Leon Simmons
characters.line: Franklin's right hand, increasingly boxed in by rising wholesaler Manboy.

characters.name: Drew "Manboy" Miller
characters.line: Crips wholesaler moving Family crack, publicly at war with the Bloods, at odds with Franklin over price.

characters.name: Terrence "Skully" Brown
characters.line: Bloods leader distributing Family crack in Inglewood; already at war with his in-law Manboy.

beats.label: S4 · Fake limp
beats.text: Fourteen months later, Franklin fakes a limp to look diminished and plays the escalating Bloods–Crips war for profit, siding with the Crips to ambush Skully.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Sets Franklin's whole-season strategy: manipulate both sides of the war while appearing weakened.

beats.label: S4 · Fuentes falls
beats.text: Tijuana's new police chief Fuentes has Hernan and Nuvia killed; Teddy gets the retaliation sanctioned and Gustavo strangles Fuentes himself.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cements Gustavo's dependence on Teddy and secures the Mexico corridor for the rest of the show.

beats.label: S4 · Tianna
beats.text: In a shootout with the Bloods, Leon and his men kill Skully's young daughter Tianna, turning the entire Bloods faction into a personal vendetta hunting Leon.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The killing of Tianna reshapes the gang war and gives Leon the guilt that pulls him toward retirement.

beats.label: S4 · Irene's article
beats.text: Reporter Irene Abe, tipped off by Marino, prints the story of Teddy's CIA cocaine trade; Alton corroborates it on the record.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The article puts Teddy under direct threat and directly causes both Irene's and Alton's murders.

beats.label: S4 · Manboy dies
beats.text: Franklin's girlfriend Tanosse is exposed as Manboy's spy on the Family; Franklin lures Manboy into a trap and kills him, then has Jerome execute Khadijah.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes Franklin's largest street rival and ends the season's gang-war arc with Franklin dominant.

beats.label: S4 · Alton killed
beats.text: Teddy suffocates Irene to bury her article, then follows Alton to Havana and murders him too; Cissy believes only that Alton went into exile.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Alton's murder is the emotional pivot for Cissy's entire next-season arc against Teddy.

beats.label: S4 · Uncle walks out
beats.text: Louie and Jerome quit the Family to buy wholesale from Franklin; he then silently confirms killing Andre to Melody and walks out of her house without his limp.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Two ruptures in one beat — Franklin's own family splits off, and he lets his most damaging secret out.

cliffhanger.text: Franklin has dropped the pretence of weakness and rules the streets, but Louie and Jerome are now his customers and rivals, and Cissy is grieving an Alton she doesn't know was murdered by Teddy.
questions: How long can Franklin's split from his own uncle stay peaceful?
Will Cissy ever find out Teddy killed Alton?
Can Melody keep his confession to herself?

characters.name: Franklin Saint
characters.line: Undisputed street boss, limp abandoned, at odds with his own uncle and aunt.

characters.name: Teddy McDonald
characters.line: CIA operator with two murders on his hands this season and no family left to answer to.

characters.name: Gustavo "El Oso" Zapata
characters.line: Grieving Hernan and Nuvia, welded to Teddy after being saved from Fuentes.

characters.name: Cissy Saint
characters.line: Believes Alton went to Havana and is missing; still central to Franklin's household.

characters.name: Jerome Saint
characters.line: Quit the Family with Louie; now Franklin's wholesale customer, no longer his partner.

characters.name: Louie Jones
characters.line: The one who pushed the split; runs her own trade with Jerome buying from Franklin.

characters.name: Leon Simmons
characters.line: Hollowed out by having killed Tianna; hunted by every Blood in the city.

characters.name: Wanda Bell
characters.line: Newly sober after Leon locked her down; back at his side after saving him from a Bloods shooter.

characters.name: Melody Wright
characters.line: Sober again, living out of town, and the only outside person who knows Franklin killed her father.

characters.name: Terrence "Skully" Brown
characters.line: Bloods leader who has lost his daughter; hunts Leon, deeply unstable.

beats.label: S5 · Teddy retakes
beats.text: Some months on, Teddy poisons his replacement Grady Williamson to reclaim the operation and hikes prices back up on Franklin, straining their partnership.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Puts Teddy back in direct control and creates the price friction Louie later exploits.

beats.label: S5 · Cissy's pact
beats.text: Cissy returns from Havana convinced Teddy killed Alton and secretly promises KGB agent Rubén she will help kill Teddy in exchange for proof.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Cissy's decision drives the season's assassination plot and directly leads to who fires the fatal shot in S6.

beats.label: S5 · Kane returns
beats.text: Kevin's older brother Kane leaves prison and, with Franklin's bodyguard Peaches secretly helping, launches coordinated attacks on Franklin, Louie, Jerome and Leon.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Introduces Kane and the traitor Peaches — the streetside pressure that runs through both remaining seasons.

beats.label: S5 · Louie's deal
beats.text: Louie strikes a private supply deal with Teddy behind Franklin's back, formalising her split from the Family and locking Franklin's paranoia in place.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The Louie–Teddy backchannel is the specific betrayal Franklin retaliates against with the S5 finale robberies.

beats.label: S5 · Wedding trip
beats.text: At Louie and Jerome's wedding, Skully spikes the chocolate fountain with LSD; a hallucinating Franklin faces his own monstrousness while Louie confesses she killed Claudia.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's emotional peak; forces Franklin to see himself clearly for the first time.

beats.label: S5 · Fortune stolen
beats.text: Teddy steals Franklin's entire laundered fortune and uses it to buy his way back into the CIA proper, leaving Franklin functionally broke.
beats.whyLoadBearing: This theft becomes Franklin's sole motivation for the entire next season.

beats.label: S5 · The last split
beats.text: Franklin retaliates by robbing Louie and Jerome's spots, ending the Family for good; Cissy tells him she is now dealing with the KGB and wants in on killing Teddy.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Aligns Franklin and Cissy against Teddy and sets up the three-sided war (Franklin, Louie/Jerome, Teddy) of S6.

cliffhanger.text: Franklin is broke, at open war with his own uncle and aunt, and has just aligned with his mother and a KGB agent to kill Teddy — the only man who knows where his money went.
questions: Can Franklin get his fortune back if the only person who can move it is the one they want dead?
How much of the KGB deal will Cissy actually tell Franklin?
Which side survives the Franklin–Louie–Jerome war?

characters.name: Franklin Saint
characters.line: Bankrupt, at war with Louie and Jerome, and plotting with his mother to kill his CIA partner.

characters.name: Teddy McDonald
characters.line: Back inside the CIA using stolen money; living with a surgeon named Parissa.

characters.name: Cissy Saint
characters.line: Back from Havana, secretly working with KGB agent Rubén to avenge Alton.

characters.name: Veronique Turner
characters.line: Franklin's pregnant girlfriend, sworn to his cause but wary of what he has become.

characters.name: Jerome Saint
characters.line: At open war with Franklin after being robbed on his own wedding weekend.

characters.name: Louie Jones
characters.line: Now married to Jerome and buying cocaine straight from Teddy; still burying that she killed Claudia.

characters.name: Leon Simmons
characters.line: Retired from the drug trade and about to leave for Africa with Wanda.

characters.name: Gustavo "El Oso" Zapata
characters.line: Arrested by the DEA while trying to withdraw his money — off the board for now.

characters.name: Rubén
characters.line: KGB agent handling Cissy; the outside player driving the anti-Teddy plot.

characters.name: Kane Hamilton
characters.line: Kevin's older brother, wounded but alive, running a Crips crew against the Family.

beats.label: S6 · Three-sided war
beats.text: Franklin undercuts Louie and Jerome by supplying Deon directly; Jerome hunts down and brutalises Franklin's bounty hunter Black Diamond over the stolen money.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the open family war and Jerome's willingness to kill people close to Franklin.

beats.label: S6 · Cassandra's sting
beats.text: Veronique's con-artist mother Cassandra helps Franklin sting Teddy's accountant, only to realise the money's location lives solely inside Teddy's head.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Fixes Franklin's goal for the rest of the show: he must capture Teddy alive to recover his fortune.

beats.label: S6 · Gustavo flips
beats.text: Rubén threatens Gustavo's family into planting cocaine to frame Teddy; Gustavo confesses to Franklin instead and switches sides to keep Xiamara and the children safe.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns Teddy's most loyal partner against him and gives Franklin the muscle to physically capture Teddy.

beats.label: S6 · Uncle and Kane
beats.text: Louie is kidnapped and tortured by Kane; Franklin and Jerome storm his compound together to save her, and Jerome and Kane kill each other in the shootout.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Removes both Kane and Jerome in one beat, breaks the Franklin–Louie relationship, and leaves Louie a widow.

beats.label: S6 · Teddy captured
beats.text: Louie helps Franklin trap Teddy; Teddy confesses he stole the money out of hurt pride, agrees to split it back, and Franklin plans to hand him and Rubén to the CIA.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The season's central objective is finally in reach — Teddy alive, cooperative, promising the money.

beats.label: S6 · Cissy fires
beats.text: At the payphone drop for Teddy's bank, he taunts Cissy about killing Alton; she shoots him dead before he can transfer a cent and calmly surrenders to police.
beats.whyLoadBearing: In one act, Cissy avenges Alton and destroys Franklin's only chance of getting his fortune back.

beats.label: S6 · Alone
beats.text: Veronique flees with what's left of Franklin's money; years on, Leon returns from Ghana and finds Franklin a rambling alcoholic in Cissy's condemned house, refusing his help.
beats.whyLoadBearing: The closing image of the whole series — the price of every choice Franklin made across six seasons.

cliffhanger.text: The series ends with Cissy serving life for Teddy's murder and Franklin, years later, broke and alcoholic in her condemned house, walking away from Leon's offer of a way out and declaring himself "free from all of it."
questions: Where did Veronique and Franklin's child end up after she fled with the money?
How long can Louie stay hidden on her ranch with Marino still hunting her?
Is Franklin's rejection of Leon a final choice or the bottom of a longer fall?

characters.name: Franklin Saint
characters.line: Broke, alone, alcoholic in his mother's condemned house; has just refused Leon's offer of a job and a way out.

characters.name: Cissy Saint
characters.line: Serving a life sentence without parole for shooting Teddy dead at the payphone.

characters.name: Leon Simmons
characters.line: Back from Accra with Wanda, running a legal clinic in South Central and trying to pull Franklin out.

characters.name: Wanda Bell
characters.line: Married to Leon; took over Alton's shelter earlier this season and returned with Leon to Los Angeles.

characters.name: Louie Jones
characters.line: Widowed, on the run from Marino, working as a hired hand on a ranch under a false identity.

characters.name: Gustavo "El Oso" Zapata
characters.line: Living quietly in Mexico as a wrestling teacher, on his way to reunite with Xiamara and the nephews in North Carolina.

characters.name: Veronique Turner
characters.line: Gone with the last of Franklin's money and their child, having called him only once to say the baby was born.
